name: ARA-290
description: Synthetic 11-amino-acid peptide (cibinetide), designed from part of erythropoietin (EPO)

note.text: Araim officers co-wrote several trials. No trial has tested it for muscle or sports injuries, and no Phase 3 trial has been run.

bullets: **Designed from EPO,** but does not raise red blood cell production
**Innate repair receptor:** the developer's described target
**Tissue protection** and lower inflammation linked to it in animal studies
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

notEstablished.text: Use for muscle or sports injury

practical.routes: Into a vein; injection under the skin (trials)
practical.monitored: Nerve symptoms, corneal nerve fibers, HbA1c
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; class S2.1.5 may apply

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide policy

references: Culver et al., ARA-290 Phase 2b in sarcoidosis, Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci, May 2017
Brines et al., ARA-290 in type 2 diabetes, Mol Med, Mar 2015
